self_sha256_note: This preregistration config deliberately does NOT embed its own SHA256 to avoid a self-reference paradox. The external SHA256 is recorded by the run report, the run harness result JSON and the preregistration report JSON.

preregistration_report.sha256_note: written immediately after this config; it pins this config's SHA256

preregistered_before_metrics: This file and the preregistration report are written before any new validation NPZ is read for this experiment.
purpose: Test whether replacing the weak task-specific semantic teacher (arm A control) with the preregistered bbox/point spatial teacher (arm B primary) makes the existing hardware-cheap prompt_mean_vector student learn task-conditioned spatial token scores, without changing the frozen architecture, feature cache, split, optimizer, or hardware contract.

scope.small_head_note: about 458752 trainable parameters in a Wt[128,2560]/Wv[128,1024] head; this is NOT 4B model training

immutability_rule: Every pinned input and the preregistration config/report pair must be byte-for-byte unchanged before and after the experiment; the run records the pre-run and post-run SHA256 of every pinned input.

frozen_spatial_targets.grounding_area_target: for each grid cell, exact bbox/grid-cell intersection area with bbox_1000 clipped to [0,1000] for boundary tolerance only; divide by total intersection area so mass sums to 1; hard-fail invalid or zero/negative-area boxes; applicable task: grounding
frozen_spatial_targets.pointing_bilinear_target: u=x*W/1000-0.5, v=y*H/1000-0.5; clamp u to [0,W-1], v to [0,H-1]; separable bilinear mass over the up to four neighboring centers; combine duplicate boundary indices and normalize to sum 1; no Gaussian and no bandwidth parameter; applicable task: pointing
frozen_spatial_targets.no_blending: spatial targets are never blended with the cached semantic teacher target
frozen_spatial_targets.no_tuning: target formulas are frozen before any metric and are not tuned after seeing metrics

split_rule.test_npz_action: never resolved, hashed, opened or scored; frozen index metadata is used only to compute test paths for the isolation log

arms.name: B_SPATIAL_KL_PRIMARY
arms.target: grounding: exact bbox/grid-cell area target; pointing: bilinear point target

loss_definition.image_pair_loss: mean of the grounding record loss and the pointing record loss
loss_definition.batch_loss: mean of the image-pair losses in the deterministic image-pair batch
loss_definition.target_arm_B: frozen spatial target per record (grounding area target, pointing bilinear target)

optimization.model_selection: best checkpoint selected only by each arm's own val KL (arm A: semantic val KL, arm B: spatial val KL)

validation_metrics.record_to_image_aggregation: average grounding and pointing record metrics before resampling
validation_metrics.same_image_other_task_control: score the same visual groups with the paired task prompt of the same image; deltas are correct minus wrong for Spearman and full NDCG
validation_metrics.cross_image_same_task_derangement: descriptive secondary control; deterministic split-local image derangement with same-task donor and no self-pair
validation_metrics.deployed_selection_proxy: at K=48 (descriptive also at K=64/96) use the existing score normalization/combine rule of evaluation.hardware_regular_token_selector.combine_scores with lambda_semantic from configs/hardware_regular_token_selector.json and the exact existing select_real_groups 3x3 anchor rule; arm B prompt-conditioned selector retained spatial-target mass is compared with the L2+anchor baseline retained spatial-target mass
validation_metrics.deployed_ndcg: evaluation.prompt_projection_distillation.ndcg_for_selected_indices (corrected selected-set NDCG) whenever deployed NDCG is reported

statistics.seed_aggregation: per-image median delta across the three seeds before bootstrap/permutation
primary_holm_family: B_SPATIAL_KL_PRIMARY minus A_SEMANTIC_KL_CONTROL: correct spatial Spearman
B_SPATIAL_KL_PRIMARY minus A_SEMANTIC_KL_CONTROL: correct spatial full NDCG
B_SPATIAL_KL_PRIMARY correct minus same-image-other-task: spatial Spearman
B_SPATIAL_KL_PRIMARY correct minus same-image-other-task: spatial full NDCG
B_SPATIAL_KL_PRIMARY deployed selector minus L2+anchor at K48: retained spatial-target mass
statistics.primary_metric_policy: only these five tests decide the result; other K/method metrics are descriptive and cannot decide the result

gates.G1_spatial_supervision_gain: both B-A correct spatial Spearman and full NDCG deltas satisfy: mean > 0, 95% CI lower > 0, |dz| >= 0.2, Holm p < 0.05, positive mean in >= 2/3 seeds
gates.G2_prompt_sensitivity: both B correct-vs-same-image-other-task Spearman and full NDCG deltas satisfy the same five conditions
gates.G3_deployed_K48_utility: B prompt-conditioned selector minus L2+anchor retained spatial-target mass delta at K48 satisfies the same five conditions
gates.G4_collapse_removed: exact prompt-score invariance fraction <= 0.05 in every seed for arm B
gates.G5_validation_learning: >= 2/3 B seeds have best_epoch > 0 and best val spatial KL < epoch0 val spatial KL
gates.G6_hardware_contract: runtime query remains [1,128]; FPGA scorer remains Gx128 dot; no token-axis max/softmax/exp; existing fixed-budget 3x3 anchor selection unchanged

decision_rule.SPATIAL_STUDENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED: arm B fails any of G1-G6
decision_rule.control_rule: arm A is a control and can never win
decision_rule.internal_test: no internal test evaluation in either case

prohibitions: no third arm and no arm target substitution after the preregistration
no pair hinge, target blending, margin, rank loss, auxiliary loss or hyperparameter search
no reading, resolving, hashing or scoring of internal test NPZ files
no internal test evaluation in either decision branch
no 4B model load, no feature re-extraction, no raw image read, no GPU, no network, no package installation
no post-hoc change of the five-test Holm family, the gates or the decision rule
no post-hoc change of the corrected selected-set NDCG helper
no claim of CV-Bench task accuracy, hardware speedup or board deployment
authorization: DeepSeek Harness may process necessary code, metrics and derived data via api.deepseek.com; raw images, 4B weights, keys, proxy config and credentials are never read, uploaded or printed.
